scripts.cleanup: bun run format && bun run lint-fix
scripts.check-for-ai: bun install > /dev/null && bun run format > /dev/null 2> /dev/null || true && bun run typecheck && bun run lint
scripts.check-all-for-ai: bun run check-for-ai && bun run test
scripts.deploy: bun run deploy:setup && bun run railway up --ci -m "${DEPLOY_MESSAGE:-Deploy to Railway}"
scripts.deploy:setup: bun run railway link --project=${RAILWAY_PROJECT_ID} --service=${RAILWAY_SERVICE_ID} --environment=${WB_ENV} && sh -c 'if [ "${WB_ENV}" = "production" ]; then DB_URL="file:/data/production.sqlite3"; else DB_URL="file:./drizzle/mount/${WB_ENV}.sqlite3"; fi; bun run railway variables --service=${RAILWAY_SERVICE_ID} --environment=${WB_ENV} --skip-deploys --set="DATABASE_URL=${DB_URL}" --set="NODE_ENV=production" --set="WB_ENV=${WB_ENV}"'
